settings.label: Media Directory
settings.description:
The folder Local Files shows
[DEFAULT] On the OSD/OS image, the Movies folder on the card's OSD-OS partition, where films copied onto the card from a computer go; elsewhere Movies in a media folder in the data folder

settings.label: Shuffle Playback
settings.description:
Play playlists in random order.
[ASK] lets you choose each time a playlist starts.

settings.label: Auto Show Subtitles
settings.description:
Choose to automatically show subtitles when a video starts.
[FORCED ONLY] displays for foreign dialogue only.

settings.label: Subtitle Language
settings.description:
Select which language to automatically load subtitles for.
[Any] is the same as 'no preference'.

settings.label: Image Duration
settings.description:
How long an image is shown before advancing.
Applies to images in folders and playlists.

settings.label: Scaling
settings.description:
How a 16:9 picture fills the 4:3 screen in this module
[DEFAULT] As Settings' Scaling says
